title: Add receiver-side A2A idempotency result cache
summary: Persist receiver-side idempotency results so duplicate deliveries with the same key can return the original result without repeating external side effects.
expectedFailureModes: A redelivered idempotent task executes side effects again instead of replaying the original result.
Result cache keys are scoped too broadly and collide across senders, recipients, or task types.
Operators enable periodic retry before receivers can prove duplicate deliveries are deduplicated.
verification: cd agent-os && cargo test -p covenantd a2a --locked
humanEscalation: Approval before enabling any periodic background retry scheduler by default.
nextAction: Design and implement durable receiver-side idempotency result caching scoped by sender, recipient, task kind, and idempotency key.
